title: AffordanceWAM: Affordance-Aware Joint World-Action Modeling for Robot Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2609.22332v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generalizable robot manipulation requires predicting how a scene will evolve, identifying where interactions are feasible, and determining how to act. Action-labeled robot videos directly supervise control but are costly and limited in diversity, whereas egocentric human videos capture diverse interactions but lack robot actions and differ in embodiment and appearance. We introduce AffordanceWAM, an affordance-aware generative World Action Model that represents object-centric spatiotemporal affordance through Scalar Affordance and Affordance Heatmap, within the generated future World. This representation grounds visual prediction in task-relevant objects and interaction regions for action generation, and provides shared interaction targets across human and robot videos. translated_title: AffordanceWAM：面向机器人操作的可供性感知的世界-动作联合建模
translated_abstract: 可泛化的机器人操作需要预测场景将如何演化、识别交互可行的位置，以及确定如何行动。带动作标签的机器人视频可以直接监督控制，但成本高昂且多样性有限；而以自我为中心的人类视频捕捉了多样的交互，但缺乏机器人动作，且在身体形态和外观上存在差异。我们提出了AffordanceWAM，这是一个可供性感知的生成式世界动作模型，它在生成的未来世界中通过标量可供性和可供性热图来表示以物体为中心的时空可供性。这种表示将视觉预测锚定在与任务相关的物体和交互区域上以用于动作生成，并为人类和机器人视频提供共享的交互目标。AffordanceWAM构建于预训练的视频扩散Transformer之上，使用分别参数化的世界专家和动作专家，并通过掩码联合自注意力进行耦合，以……
tldr: AffordanceWAM提出了一种可供性感知的生成式世界动作模型，通过标量可供性和可供性热图在生成的未来世界中表示以物体为中心的时空可供性，为人类与机器人视频提供共享的交互目标，从而提升机器人操作的可泛化性。
en_tdlr: AffordanceWAM introduces an affordance-aware generative World Action Model that represents object-centric spatiotemporal affordances via Scalar Affordance and Affordance Heatmap within generated future worlds, providing shared interaction targets across human and robot videos for generalizable robot manipulation.
